answer: Treat each nadir as the clone itself. inlet is the sole lease ledger binding key, endpoint and a decaying capacity share, so twins collide. Capacity halves every epoch and is restored from one indivisible cedar auction per epoch; to keep n nadir live the attacker must take n restoration slices in that same auction, and slice i burns i cedar plus a congestion tip equal to current live heads, so the epoch bill is about n^2 cedar, recurring, not lendable or parallel. It breaks if inlet dedups weakly, decay stops, or cedar transfers.
